crossRefs.note: the food of his table, the sitting of his servants, the attendance of his officials, their clothing, his cup bearers…
When these days were fulfilled, the king made a seven day feast for all the people who were present in Susa the palace…
There were hangings of white and blue material, fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and marble…
He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;
for God is not a God of confusion, but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.
Let all things be done decently and in order.

translations.web: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.
translations.bsb: Then Jesus directed them to have the people sit in groups on the green grass.
translations.kjv: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.
translations.asv: And he commanded them that all should sit down by companies upon the green grass.
